title: TLS issue with web endpoints on new, custom domains

updates.message:
Due to an [active incident at Let's Encrypt](https://letsencrypt.status.io/), we are unable to issue SSL certificates for web endpoints on new, custom domains (eg., `yourwebsite.com`).

* New web endpoints using our default `modal.run` domain are unaffected.
* Existing web endpoints for which we have already issued certificates are unaffected.
* We renew certificates 30 days in advance, so we do not expect any certificates to expire.

We are actively testing a backup provider which we may bring online if the incident continues.
We have added a backup provider for SSL certificates, and issuance has resumed successfully.

title: CPU functions, GPU functions, and 5 other services are down

updates.message: CPU functions, Snapshot restores (beta), and Image builds went down.
GPU functions and Sandboxes went down.

We are actively looking into remediating this issue.

In the mean time, Modal dashboard log in is not available, and we are keeping tabs on any other services that are affected.
Our team is monitoring the remediation we've made to our system that are going out. Services have recovered.

## Impact

Our authorization system will be briefly unavailable during the restart. Any request that requires a permission check will fail with an error for approximately **30–60 seconds**.

This affects all API operations, including calling functions, accessing apps and storage, and managing resources such as volumes and environments. An increase in failure rates will occur during the restart window for a period of ~30 seconds, affecting approximately ~15% of requests, as the majority of requests are served from cache or will be retried by the Modal client.

## Recovery
Once the restart is complete, all operations resume normally with no action required on your end.
